bagPolicy.summary: The Hamilton Live hasn't published bag policy details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

parking.summary: The Hamilton validates parking at the Joyce Parking garage at 1325 G Street NW after 4pm. Bring your ticket with you to the venue to get the validation.
parking.quote: We validate at the JOYCE PARKING garage at 1325 G Street NW for $13 after 4:00 pm.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The Hamilton Live. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The venue kitchen is open before and during the show, and items from the upstairs menu can be ordered to go at the upstairs bars and brought down to the venue. Outside wine is allowed if it isn't on The Hamilton's wine list, with a corkage fee, and outside desserts carry a per-person fee.
concessions.quote: The venue kitchen is open before and during the show.

accessibility.summary: The Hamilton has an elevator for venue access, and advance notice of the access you need is welcome. Staff can't automatically upgrade your ticket, but they can help you find a suitable viewing spot.
accessibility.quote: We have an elevator for venue access.

reEntry.summary: The Hamilton Live hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office opens at 5:30pm on show nights. Bring a valid ID or your confirmation email to pick up will call tickets, or print your ticket at home with the barcode to be scanned. A valid ID showing you're 21 or older is required to drink, whatever the show's age limit.
ticketPickup.quote: A valid ID or confirmation email is needed to pick up will call tickets.

gates.summary: Doors open at 6:30pm unless the show listing says otherwise. The line forms outside or inside The Hamilton's F Street entrance, depending on the weather.
gates.quote: The line may form either outside or inside the F Street entrance of The Hamilton depending on weather.
